title: Vault Door to Nightmare
description: A figure in an orange prison jumpsuit labeled GHI827 stands with their back to the viewer, opening a massive circular vault door. Beyond the doorway is a surreal, hellish landscape with twisted trees, string lights, and a purple-green sky. Film reels and torn movie posters litter the concrete floor of the derelict room.
prompt: A prisoner in an orange jumpsuit with GHI827 printed on the back stands at a giant open bank vault door, one hand on the wheel lock. The character has a pale white face with dark makeup and is looking back over their shoulder. Beyond the door is a twisted purple and green nightmare landscape with dead trees and string lights. Old film reels and movie posters are scattered on the floor of a decaying room, cinematic lighting, detailed digital painting.
